title: AI readiness of the federal statistical system: host-level findings
description: Host-level AI-readiness findings for the sixteen recognized agencies and units of the US federal statistical system, plus three federal reference hosts shown separately. Six host-level checks over one measurement cycle with one declared client identity, every verdict traceable to the Finding, the rule version and the retained response body that produced it. The matrices, the per-check source appendix and every registered Result the report quotes are published as data beside it; the PDF is a view of them.
